assessments.kind: bounded current source relationship; no new issue counted
assessments.contract: EquipmentSurfaceSpan is a public struct with a Vec of regions, anchor enum and f32 coverage, plus derived Deserialize; its own declaration does not enforce a nonempty/contiguous chain, finite strictly positive coverage or maximum count. OccupancyRequirement likewise combines independently typed location, channel, order and optional fit zone, but the declaration alone does not ensure a fit zone belongs to its location. Direct literals and independent deserialization therefore are distinct raw construction routes from the build compiler’s validated catalog path.
assessments.condition: This does not prove invalid DTOs reach a production consumer that assumes validation. Format-specific deserializer capabilities, compiled feature selection, other constructors and mutation/retained consumers require separate tracing. No product, test or fixture was run.
assessments.future_direction: Trace every material route to retained equipment state and decide whether validated owners or an explicit validated catalog boundary should own cross-field surface and fit invariants. Preserve valid absent-zone and non-armor optional-surface modes.
relationships: 774 rig CONTRACT-042/043 and catalogue-helper-admission-002 already distinguish raw authoring DTO from validated compiled content; current observations are independently registered, not a new duplicate issue.
059 Q1557 and Q1749 are wider pending identity/fit and allocator relationships; central reviewer decides exact links without automatic alias.

assessments.kind: bounded nonfinding for inspected serialized build path
assessments.contract: The inspected build source parses item documents, invokes validate_documents_with_sources before serializing embedded output, and treats errors as fatal. The validator calls occupancy checks, surface checks and a final typed ItemCatalogDocument decode; the occupancy helper checks fit-zone/location and conflicts when typed entry parsing succeeds, while final typed decoding records malformed field types. The surface helper enforces nonempty armor/clothing spans, valid ordered contiguous region chains, a 16-segment total, selected anchor, optional protection/material relationships, and positive f32 coverage no greater than one. Its numeric helper tests positivity and finiteness after f32 conversion.
assessments.condition: This is a static trace of the shown compiler path, not evidence that a build was run, all input sources/callers follow it, or direct raw DTO constructors are checked. Final decode and diagnostics depend on the inspected caller actually using this compiler path. None of the existing tests was executed.
assessments.future_direction: Keep the explicit serialized admission gate connected to any other actual source of EquipmentPlacement, and reconcile with callers without globally narrowing a generic unit fraction or changing allowed optional modes.
relationships: The same bounded distinction and typed-decode dependency was recorded in earlier rig contracts 044/046/047; those earlier reads and excluded P16 test tails stay attributed to rig.

assessments.kind: bounded current nonfinding; broader producer and policy open
assessments.contract: The conflict method requires the same location and channel; singleton channels conflict regardless of order, non-singleton channels require equal order, and an omitted fit zone reserves the whole location within that channel/order condition while equal explicit zones overlap. Arm zones are only paired with arm locations and leg zones with leg locations.
assessments.condition: The method does not itself validate that a caller supplied a compatible zone/location. The inspected compiler helper validates that combination for typed entries, but equipment graph allocation, runtime decisions and all caller input modes are not covered.
assessments.future_direction: Reconcile actual allocator semantics and normalized identities with Q1557/Q1749 before changing representation or classifying a missing zone as an error.

nonfindings: Disjoint explicit zones in the same channel/order need not conflict; None denotes whole-location reservation only under matching location/channel/order rules.
The build-path surface coverage helper checks the f32 result, so a positive source value that rounds to zero is rejected on that shown path.
A DTO being publicly constructible is an admission boundary to trace, not proof of an actual unsafe consumer.
open_questions: Can direct DTO construction or alternate deserializers feed actual retained equipment state without the catalog validator, and which consumers rely on the policy?
How do allocator, parent selection and persisted identity interact with fit-zone None and collision rules?
Are duplicated validator region strings and enum representations consistently maintained in other inputs or future revisions?
How do Q1557/Q1749 and 774 camera/rig records connect to other findings? Central reconciliation required.

perspectives.producer-propagation: Serialized catalog documents pass validators then typed decode and embedded runtime source; independent external DTO producers and actual consumers remain open.
perspectives.existing-type-owners: EquipmentFitZone, EquipmentLocation, SurfaceAnchor and EquipmentAnatomicalRegion already own closed distinctions; coverage positivity and chain topology remain separate aggregate policies.
perspectives.admission: Public DTO literals and derived deserialization admit independent raw states; the inspected build path has explicit aggregate and post-f32 checks.
perspectives.invariant-operations: Coverage conversion and conflict comparisons preserve only the contracts their actual callers establish; later mutations are unreviewed.
perspectives.aggregate-states: Zone/location compatibility, channel/order overlap and continuous anatomical chains cannot follow from leaf enum validity alone.
perspectives.type-ownership: Catalog validation and its compiled-content boundary own the inspected policy; a replacement checked owner must be connected to every material producer.
perspectives.redundant-authority: Schema enums, string validation lists and serde conversions are multiple representations of related admitted values; exact synchronization/ownership impact beyond these paths is open.
perspectives.behavior-preservation: Whole-location omission, layered orders, optional nonarmor surfaces and distinct anchor modes are intentional supported conditions in the shown sources.
perspectives.enum-shapes: Closed zone and anchor enums suit these distinct states; this scope does not justify reshaping parent/attachment variants.
perspectives.derivability: Existing derived serde/traits do not enforce cross-field rules; no removable handwritten boilerplate is proved here.
perspectives.type-granularity: Positive bounded coverage is distinct from a generic [0,1] unit interval because zero is rejected; whole-location and discrete fit zones are distinct options.
perspectives.magic-strings: Serde tags and actual validator region lists encode a catalog boundary; no independent user-visible string-classifier failure is established.
perspectives.magic-numbers: The 16-segment budget and maximum coverage 1 belong to serialized catalog policy; order values and channel layering remain separate.

limitations: Static source inspection and evidence verification only; no product builds, tests, probes, simulations, fixtures or rendering.
